prompt: In a flat vector illustration, the interior of a fire station garage is depicted with clean lines and solid colors. On the left stands a tall firefighter in a yellow helmet, holding a coiled hose that rests on the floor. Next to him is a shiny red fire truck with chrome bumpers. A small boy in a blue cap sits on the truck's front bumper, looking up at the firefighter. In the center, a woman in a green apron hands a white mug to a man in a gray suit who is standing beside her. The man in the gray suit points toward the ceiling where a silver bell hangs. Above them, a black cat sleeps on a high wooden shelf, ignoring the activity below. To the right of the central pair, a brown dog lies on a checkered rug, chewing on a rubber bone. Behind the dog, an elderly man in a plaid shirt leans against a locker, watching the scene with a smile. Near the back wall, a young girl in a pink dress holds a toy fireman doll. She stands next to a large map pinned to the wall. A mechanic in blue overalls kneels beside the rear wheel of the fire truck, tightening a bolt with a wrench. Above the mechanic, a clock shows three o'clock. On the far right, a potted cactus sits on a metal desk. A stack of orange books rests on the desk next to the cactus. There is no smoke in the air. There is no fire visible in the scene.
